name: OT - Claroty CTD alert (suppressed by asset and signature)
description: Turns Claroty CTD alerts ingested through the Claroty CTD integration into Elastic detection alerts, grouping repeated identical alerts (same destination asset and same Claroty alert name) into a single alert with a suppressed-document count for 1 hour. Intended to keep one contextualised item per asset and signature for analyst triage.
false_positives: Scheduled maintenance by a known-good engineering workstation (see ot-assets: asset.known_good and asset.maintenance_window).
note: Triage: open the Asset and Firewall Context dashboard for the destination asset, confirm known_good and maintenance window in the asset metadata, confirm the FortiGate rule hit (policy ENG-to-PLC-S7) and the authorised engineer logon on the source workstation. Close the case as a false positive if all match.
